description: Extra-context merge boundary coverage: multiple context keys merge in deterministic (sorted) order, and non-string values are merged faithfully — a number, a boolean, and a nested object are each rendered as compact JSON on the event root rather than being stringified or dropped. A single-key context is also exercised.

cases.expected_output:

event_id_length=32
last_event_id=0

url=https://sentry.io/api/123/store/
platform=c
message=
merged.a=1
merged.b=2
merged.count=5
